fields.description: Nikki Beach Residences is Aldar’s branded beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah. It offers one-to-five-bedroom residences with a combination of furnished and unfurnished choices, shared leisure facilities and a hospitality-led service offering.

sources.label: Aldar: Nikki Beach brochure and typical layouts
Savills: Nikki Beach Residences Al Marjan Island

overview: The residences bring a beach-club setting into a residential community. The brochure shows outdoor terraces, open living areas and layouts ranging from compact apartments to large sky terraces. A resident-services offering accompanies the shared leisure spaces; included services and separately charged requests should be checked in the management agreement.
research.locationNote: Aldar places the community between Rixos Bab Al Bahr and DoubleTree by Hilton on Al Marjan Island. Access to the beach, the exact outlook and any hotel privileges should be verified for the individual residence.
research.priceNote: The linked sales presentation starts one-bedroom homes at AED 2.37m. This undated brochure figure is not live inventory.
research.paymentNote: The reported 60/40 structure comprises 10% booking, 50% during construction and 40% at handover. Resale contracts can carry different balances; obtain the selected unit’s statement of account.
research.handoverNote: The official presentation gives 2028; Savills and Property Finder report Q4. Reconfirm the contractual completion date.

facts.label: Original release
facts.value: Aldar’s November 2023 announcement described approximately 800 residences, with 357 apartments in the first release, plus furnished and unfurnished choices. This launch count is not current available inventory.
